label: Role-based access control (RBAC)
description: Roles carried as claims and checked declaratively at the endpoint. Adds a backend-permissions skill covering role constants, deny-by-default, and where to enforce.

vars.name: role-based (RBAC)
claude_rules: Authorization is role-based and deny-by-default — a new endpoint is closed unless it explicitly opts out
quality_checks: Every new endpoint has an explicit authorization decision — inherited, narrowed, or deliberately `[AllowAnonymous]`

context: Authorization is role-based; role constants live in one file and are referenced, never typed as string literals
rules: Every new endpoint gets an explicit authorization decision — never leave it to the default by accident
